Goal: to get results from nReach campaigns to Hubspot by exporting data from campaign metrics page: 
steps needed to perform: 
- login 
- go to campaign metrics 
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9cd9013a-9912-4123-8ee7-9eb2eee2a255)
- hover over current campaign, e.g. consensus hk, click manage
- parse data, make sure that the links behind telegram, mail, linkedin and x profiles copied
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/49952ff8-92b2-45b6-bfe3-d0b9d5e16dd8)
- return csv with:
1.  contact name 
2. links (telegram, mail, linkedin and x profiles)
3. company name 
4. reply funnel
